messages.subject: Project Sable - Sable House, Deansgate - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to speak earlier. As discussed, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the acquisition of Sable House, 40 Deansgate, Manchester. We've agreed heads of terms in principle with Ardent at £24.75m, subject to contract and DD.

Their agent is pushing for exchange by late October. Can you let me have an engagement letter and your fee estimate, and we'll get going on title and enquiries?

Best,
Isla

Isla Fournier
Head of Acquisitions
Thornbury Properties Limited

messages.subject: RE: Project Sable - Sable House, Deansgate - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla,

Delighted to act for you again. Our engagement letter is attached, with a fee estimate of £58k-£68k plus VAT and disbursements to completion. James Osei will lead day to day with Elena Marchetti supporting.

Please send across the heads of terms and the agent's details and we'll request title and raise CPSE enquiries straight away. We can comfortably work to a late-October exchange.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
